```yaml
name: Benchmark

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  benchmark:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Rust toolchain
        uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          components: rustfmt, clippy
          cache: true

      - name: Cache Rust dependencies
        uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
        with:
          prefix-key: benchmark
          cache-all-crates: true

      - name: Install jq
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y jq

      - name: Check formatting
        run: cargo fmt --check

      - name: Lint with clippy
        run: cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings

      - name: Run tests
        run: cargo test --all

      - name: Build release binary
        run: cargo build --release

      - name: Run benchmark
        run: |
          mkdir -p benchmark_results
          cargo run --release -- --benchmark benchmark_corpus.json > benchmark_results/benchmark.json
        env:
          RUST_LOG: info

      - name: Verify accuracy threshold
        run: |
          ACC=$(jq -r '.accuracy' benchmark_results/benchmark.json)
          THRESHOLD=0.90
          echo "Accuracy: $ACC, Threshold: $THRESHOLD"
          if (( $(echo "$ACC < $THRESHOLD" | bc -l) )); then
            echo "❌ Accuracy below threshold!"
            exit 1
          else
            echo "✅ Accuracy meets threshold."
          fi

      - name: Upload benchmark results
        uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/upload-benchmark-results@main
        with:
          benchmark-results-dir: benchmark_results
          benchmark-name: waf-detector
          dry-run: false
          schema-version: 1
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          venv: false
          if-no-files-found: error

      - name: Publish benchmark dashboard
        uses: benchmark-action/github-action-benchmark@v1
        with:
          name: WAF Detector Benchmark
          tool: custom
          output-file-path: benchmark_results/benchmark.json
          gh-pages-branch: gh-pages
          gh-repository: ${{ github.repository }}
          benchmark-data-dir-path: .github/benchmarks
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          auto-push: true
          skip-fetch-gh-pages: false
          comment-always: true
          summary-always: true
          save-data-file: true
          comment-on-alert: true
          alert-threshold: 0.90
```
